overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly engaged professional presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, with a total following of 3,580. His content successfully targets academic, research, and data science communities. Engagement is remarkably high across all platforms, driven by announcements of academic publications, funding grants, software updates, and career opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, tool releases (like CooRnet v2.0), and publications focused on computational methods for identifying coordinated link sharing and disinformation.
Hiring announcements for postdocs and research opportunities for PhD students in computational social science.
Celebration of newly awarded research grants and announcements of upcoming presentations at academic conferences.

recommendations: Leverage LinkedIn's larger audience of 1,850 followers to cross-promote technical tools and publications primarily hosted on Mastodon and Bluesky.
Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn and Mastodon, as both platforms demonstrate high engagement potential but lower post volumes compared to Bluesky.
Utilize rich media, such as links, images of research findings, or project logos, to further increase engagement on high-performing announcement posts.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky is the most active and engaging platform, yielding the highest average engagement rate (6.14% per post). It acts as a primary hub for real-time academic discussions and student outreach.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon shows steady engagement (4.55% average engagement rate) from a highly technical audience, responding particularly well to software releases and methodology discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn drives the highest absolute volume of engagement (180 total interactions across 2 posts), making it the most effective channel for high-profile career opportunities and funding announcements.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
